messages:
Maya Kim: Quick sync — onboarding zeta-7b-v2 weights. HF path is hf://staging/zeta-7b-v2 and manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-7b-v2/manifest.json. Can infra confirm mirror status + checksums? I hit a 403 on presign earlier.
Noah Patel: on it. can you paste the manifest sha256?
Maya Kim: manifest sha256: 3f6a9b2c8d5e4a1f9b0c7d6e8f12345a6789b0cdef1234567890abcdef123456 (full in thread). Weight shards show names like weights-00001-of-00008.bin. Tokenizer note: merges.json present + added_tokens contains <sop> mapped to id 50256.
Jin (sre): checked S3 bucket — objects exist but bucket policy rejects GetObject unless requester-pays header present. Also saw presign attempt failed due to presign service not allowing cross-account markers.
ops-bot: mirror job queued: /mirror hf://staging/zeta-7b-v2 s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-7b-v2 --preserve-keys --concurrency=8
dev-bot: presign TTL default=3600s; recommend presign_ttl=43200s for multi-GB artifacts to avoid expired downloads during mirror.
Noah Patel: also flag: model_config.json lists "vocab_size": 50260 but tokenizer.json highest id is 50257 — mismatch will break token embedding lookup.
Maya Kim: ack. I will patch model_config to 50258 and re-run tokenizer merge (we intentionally left 2 reserved ids). Also planning to convert added_tokens into pre-tokenized vocab entries to avoid boundary shuffles.
Noah Patel: re: checksums — run locally:
```
sha256sum manifest.json
# compare against manifest.sha256 in registry
```
Maya Kim: pasted the sha above; full file is in GDrive: https://drive.redwood/repo/zeta-7b-v2/manifest.json
Li Wei: I can run the serving smoke when mirror completes. Plan: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"zeta-7b-v2","prompt":"hello"}' and also a 1k context perf sample.
Jin (sre): granting registry write after checksum verified. Also need IAM for service account redwood-sync-sa to have s3:GetObject on prefix zeta-7b-v2/* — Maya, can you confirm the principal?
Maya Kim: principal = arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-sync-sa. Also request presign endpoint whitelist for that role.
Noah Patel: added inline policy to staging bucket, but if HF mirror uses their agent we may need cross-account role. Ping me if 403 persists.
Jin (sre): once mirror finishes and checksum matches, I'll add registry entry and tag model state:ready-for-serving and mark rollout epoch. Will also attach a small smoke test harness.
Maya Kim: small tokenizer quirk to note for future onboarding: merges.json contains an entry that creates a multi-char merge that conflicts with our byte-level tokenizer fallback; example tokenization drift on sequences starting with "<sop>user:" — recommend pre-normalize to avoid.
Li Wei: noted — I'll include sample prompts in smoke to catch this.
Maya Kim: TL;DR: ops to run mirror (ops-bot queued), infra to check presign TTL & IAM (Noah/Jin), I will patch model_config/tokenizer, Li will run smoke gen, Jin will mark ready after checksum. Thanks :white_check_mark:
